import numpy as np

data = files[0]["table"]
x = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = data["intensity"]

mask = (x >= 990) & (x <= 1012)
x_f = x[mask]
y_f = y[mask]

if len(x_f) > 1:
    # manual trapezoidal integration
    area = 0.0
    for i in range(len(x_f) - 1):
        dx = x_f[i+1] - x_f[i]
        avg_y = (y_f[i] + y_f[i+1]) / 2.0
        area += dx * avg_y
else:
    area = 0.0

print(f"Points in range: {len(x_f)}")
print(f"Area: {area}")
